compute_expected_alignment_from_p_choose: compute the expected alignment tensor from stepwise probability using monotonic alignment enforcement
compute_expected_soft_attention: compute expected soft attention for monotonic infinite lookback from alignment and soft energy tensors
compute_expected_soft_attention_chunkwis: compute expected soft attention using monotonic chunkwise attention with a specified chunk size
apply_mass_preservation: apply mass preservation to assign residual alignment weights to the last source token
apply_mass_preservation_right_padding: apply mass preservation with right padding to scatter residual weights to the last valid token
